findings: All six other-language exports duplicate ordinary ph in ph2 for the six representative patterns, in both PNG and packed texture form. This is a 36-pair sample, not an all-card foreign-language audit.
Raw English tiers 0 and 1 each contain 613 identities and 140 ph2 rows with FlatSilver/Reverse. They expose no additional image, texture, decal or pattern fields. Tier 2 is empty.

Exact-product TCGplayer reference images are preserved for every special printing. Failed high-resolution URLs are recorded separately; the published thumbnail of the same exact product is preserved where needed. References are not ready-to-use isolated foil textures.
No Pokemon TCG Live installation was found in the inspected standard Program Files and LocalAppData roots; no installed game bundles were available for extraction.
